title: Install the dev APK on a phone and play stage 1-1
notes: Build: Puzzle Kingdoms > Build Android APK (dev). Install with adb (SETUP.md section 4). Done when the stage map shows in portrait and 1-1 plays to the results screen. Note FPS, touch feel, text size.

title: Review and merge feature/enemy-scaling
notes: Merge all + merge preview (D-030), 4x4 formation (D-031), stone gems (D-032), enemy strength per stage, HP x1.4 (D-033). Run dotnet + Unity tests, then merge to main.

title: Bring main up to date and start the ticket branch workflow
notes: main still has only the early docs. Fast-forward main to the current work, then every ticket branches off main as feature/PK-<id>-<name> and merges back after tests pass (CONVENTIONS.md, D-034).

title: Re-run the balance tool after the 4x4 formation and enemy scaling
notes: After PK-2. dotnet run -c Release --project Tools/Balance 300. Targets from D-026: 1-1/1-2 near 100%, 1-3 about 40% without Rally and 75-95% with it, battles 20-40 s. Record results in DECISIONS.

title: Tutorial stages 1-1 and 1-2: battles shorter than the 20-40 s target
notes: Measured 7-19 s (D-026). Accepted for now as tutorial stages; decide after the playtest whether to lengthen them.

title: Prepare the playtest: build, script, feedback form
notes: APK for testers, a short guide for what to try, and a questionnaire (fun, clarity of puzzle -> army -> battle link, Rally, length). Needs PK-1.

title: Playtest with 5+ people
notes: M1 exit criterion. Watch silently, note where people get stuck, collect the forms.

title: Go / pivot decision from the playtest
notes: Write the decision and its reasons in DECISIONS.md; adjust the ROADMAP.

title: CI: run the logic tests on every pull request
notes: GitHub Actions running dotnet test Tools/LogicTests, so a ticket branch only merges when green. Unity tests need a license on CI; leave them local for now.

title: Puzzle juice: swap, clear and fall animations, cascade feedback
notes: Easing on falls, pop on clear, combo text for cascades. Views only; logic stays as is (MoveReplay frames).

title: Reshuffle animation
notes: Board currently snaps to the reshuffled state (MoveReplay Reshuffled frame).

title: Effects for special gems (Blast, Prism) and stone breaking
notes: Creation and activation effects for D-028 specials and D-032 stones.

title: Tune touch input on a real phone
notes: Swipe threshold is 40 reference px (GemCell). Check feel on 2-3 phone sizes after PK-1.

title: War Camp: drag and drop units
notes: Today it is tap bench unit, then tap cell. Add drag from bench to cell and cell to cell; keep tap as fallback.

title: Art direction research: asset packs vs. freelancer
notes: Runs in parallel from M3 (ROADMAP). Compare cost, style fit, license. Every chosen asset goes into CREDITS.md first.

title: Isometric 3D battle scene on the same simulator
notes: Replaces the 2D debug view's presentation only; BattleSimulator stays the source of truth (D-020).

title: Placeholder unit models with Mixamo animations
notes: Idle, walk, attack, hit, die for Warrior, Archer, Mage and the goblins.

title: Rally visual effects
notes: Banner, unit glow and speed-up feedback while Rally is active.

title: Decide on a first-clear gold bonus
notes: Open question in D-022: repeat wins pay full gold. Revisit when upgrades make gold matter.

title: Music and sound effects
notes: Audio service (the only other allowed global, ARCHITECTURE.md). Licensed sounds go into CREDITS.md.

title: Performance profile on the target device
notes: Unity Profiler over USB on a mid-range Android phone; target 60 FPS in puzzle and battle.

title: Release signing: keystore and store build (AAB)
notes: Create the release keystore, keep it and its passwords out of git, add an AAB build to AndroidBuild.
